_README: Client logos for the proof band. Add an entry ONLY for a client that has agreed in writing to be named publicly — record who granted it in `permissionBy`. The band renders nothing at all while `logos` is empty, so no invented or placeholder client can reach production. Logos are shown in white chips because client marks arrive on every possible background (one of these is a black square) and a chip normalises them without recolouring anyone's brand.

logos.name: Cartracker Plus Telematics
logos._note: Credited by the brand on the mark itself and on cartrackerplustelematics.com. Joshua Adeshokan is recorded as the person who granted permission, not as the name shown on the page — a private individual's name does not belong under a company logo. Change `name` if the registered trading name differs.
